description: Report which media binaries (ffmpeg, ffprobe, ImageMagick, whisper.cpp, Python, edge-tts) are installed and available. Media tools are opt-in — call this first to see what operations are possible before attempting them.

_account.description: Optional. Override identity for THIS call: pass the AgenticMail agent name (e.g. "Fola") to authenticate as that agent. Requires AGENTICMAIL_ACCOUNT_KEYS_JSON to contain a matching key. Omit to use the default identity (AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY).

refresh.description: Re-probe the binaries instead of using the cached result (e.g. after installing one).

name: media_capabilities
